faq.q: How do police find you in Grand Theft Auto VI?
faq.a: Press previews describe a reworked wanted system where a star level triggers only if a crime is witnessed by an NPC, reported by a victim, or caught by a security system, rather than an instant map-wide alert.

faq.q: Does GTA 6 have a new evidence-based police system?
faq.a: Yes, according to preview coverage. Police track what they know about a suspect through HUD icons covering face, outfit, vehicle and weapon, building an evolving profile instead of granting omniscient tracking.

faq.q: Can you escape the police in GTA VI by changing clothes?
faq.a: Reportedly yes. Changing outfit, hair or vehicle is described as degrading police identification, and officers stop pursuing once their information about the suspect goes stale or is invalidated.

faq.q: Do police show up as dots on the minimap in GTA 6?
faq.a: According to the same coverage, cops no longer show automatically as dots on the minimap during pursuits, which fits with the described shift toward evidence-based tracking rather than automatic detection.

faq.q: Who described the GTA 6 police criminal profile system?
faq.a: Rob Nelson described the system in interviews with outlets including IGN following the Extended Look reveal, though the record does not include his exact wording on every mechanic.
